projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard platform that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents insights through visualization components.

Scope:
- Customer CSV data processing: ingestion, validation, cleaning, normalization, and loading into analytics storage.
- Application log analysis: log collection, parsing, pattern detection, metric aggregation, retention/privacy.
- Visualization components: dashboard layout, reusable chart library, customer data views, log analysis views, filters/interactivity.
- Integration, testing, and deployment.

Structure: five milestones, each broken into bounded child tasks (complexity <= 5, no task too complex to execute in isolation).

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Foundations & Requirements
tasks.details: Establish project foundations: inventory and document data sources (CSV schemas and application log formats), define dashboard KPIs and functional requirements, select the technology stack and architecture, and set up the repository, environments, and CI skeleton. This milestone unblocks all downstream data and visualization work.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Build the customer CSV processing pipeline end-to-end: upload/ingestion, schema validation and error handling, cleaning and normalization, loading into analytics storage, and automated data quality tests. Output feeds the customer-facing dashboard views.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Build the application log analysis pipeline: log collection, parsing into a structured schema, error/event pattern detection, aggregation into metrics, and a retention/privacy policy. Output feeds the log analysis dashboard views.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Design and build the dashboard UI: layout and design system, a reusable chart component library, customer data views, log analysis views, and filters/interactivity. Consumes the processed CSV data and log metrics.

tasks.name: M5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Integrate the dashboard with data APIs, run end-to-end and performance/load testing, establish the deployment pipeline and monitoring, and produce documentation and handover materials for launch.

tasks.name: Inventory & document CSV and log data sources
tasks.details: Collect sample customer CSV files and application log exports. Document schemas, field types, volumes, update frequency, encoding, delimiters, and known quality issues. Produce a data source inventory document that downstream pipeline tasks use as their contract.

tasks.name: Define dashboard KPIs & functional requirements
tasks.details: Work with stakeholders to define the dashboard's audience, primary use cases, KPIs, and must-have views for customer data and log analysis. Write concise functional requirements with acceptance criteria per view. Output: requirements spec.

tasks.name: Select tech stack & architecture
tasks.details: Choose languages, storage/warehouse, processing framework, charting library, and hosting. Produce a short architecture decision record (ADR) covering data flow from CSV/log ingestion to storage to dashboard, including trade-offs and rejected options. Keep decisions reversible where possible.

tasks.name: Set up repo, environments & CI skeleton
tasks.details: Initialize the monorepo/repo layout, local dev environment (containers or equivalent), linting/formatting, and a CI pipeline that runs lint and tests on every push. Add README with setup steps. No application features in this task.

tasks.name: Build CSV upload & ingestion endpoint
tasks.details: Implement an API/service endpoint that accepts customer CSV uploads (or reads from a drop location), stores the raw file immutably, and records ingestion metadata (filename, upload time, row count, checksum). Enforce file size/type limits. Unit-tested.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation & error handling
tasks.details: Validate incoming CSV files against the documented schema: required columns, types, nullability, allowed values, and row-level constraints. Produce a validation report with row-level errors and quarantine rejected rows rather than failing the whole file. Unit-tested with good and bad fixtures.

tasks.name: Build cleaning & normalization pipeline
tasks.details: Transform validated rows into a canonical model: trim whitespace, normalize casing, standardize dates/timezones and currency/units, deduplicate records, and map customer identifiers. Make transformations idempotent and configurable. Unit-tested against representative fixtures.

tasks.name: Load processed data into analytics storage
tasks.details: Define the analytics tables/collections and implement an idempotent upsert load of normalized customer rows into analytics storage. Include schema migration/creation scripts and handling for re-runs and partial failures.

tasks.name: Automated data quality tests for CSV pipeline
tasks.details: Add automated checks for row counts, required-field completeness, uniqueness, referential consistency, and freshness, plus regression tests for the validation/cleaning steps. Wire them into CI and fail the pipeline on regressions.

tasks.name: Set up log collection & shipping
tasks.details: Configure collectors/agents (or file-based shipping) to move application logs from source environments into the log ingestion store. Handle rotation, backpressure, and delivery retries. Verify with a small end-to-end sample of real log lines.

tasks.name: Build structured log parser
tasks.details: Parse raw log lines into a structured schema (timestamp, level, service, message, request/correlation id, error code, duration). Handle multiple known log formats and malformed lines gracefully. Unit-tested with representative fixtures including edge cases.

tasks.name: Implement error/event pattern detection
tasks.details: Detect recurring errors, anomalies, and notable events in parsed logs: group message signatures, count error bursts by service, flag new/rare patterns. Keep detection rules configurable and documented. Unit-tested with synthetic datasets.

tasks.name: Aggregate log metrics for dashboards
tasks.details: Compute dashboard-ready metrics from parsed logs: error rate over time, top error signatures, p50/p95 latency, request volume by service. Persist aggregates on a schedule and expose them via a query interface. Validated against known sample numbers.

tasks.name: Define log retention & privacy policy
tasks.details: Specify retention windows per log class, PII scrubbing/redaction rules, access controls, and deletion procedures. Implement the redaction step in the parsing path and document the policy. Reviewed against data-privacy expectations.

tasks.name: Dashboard layout & design system
tasks.details: Establish the dashboard shell: navigation, responsive grid layout, typography/color tokens, loading/empty/error states, and accessibility baseline. Deliver a component gallery/storybook page demonstrating the primitives.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement reusable, themeable chart wrappers (line, bar, stacked area, table/sparkline, KPI tile) with consistent tooltips, legends, responsive sizing, and empty/error states. Document props and add visual examples. Split into follow-up if more chart types are requested.

tasks.name: Build customer data dashboard views
tasks.details: Compose the customer-data views from the chart library and processed CSV data: customer KPIs, segmentation/overview charts, and a searchable customer table. Wire to real queries, handle loading/empty/error states, and verify against requirements acceptance criteria.

tasks.name: Build log analysis dashboard views
tasks.details: Compose the log analysis views: error-rate over time, top error signatures, latency percentiles, and service breakdown. Wire to the aggregated log metrics and verify against requirements acceptance criteria, including empty/error states.

tasks.name: Add filters, drill-downs & interactivity
tasks.details: Add global date-range and segment filters, cross-chart filtering, and drill-down interactions (e.g., click an error signature to see details). Keep URL state shareable and ensure interactions stay responsive on large datasets.

tasks.name: Integrate dashboard with data APIs
tasks.details: Connect the frontend to backend query APIs for customer data and log metrics. Define the API contract, add request caching/retries, and handle auth. Verify all dashboard views render from live (staging) data end-to-end.

tasks.name: End-to-end test suite
tasks.details: Write end-to-end tests covering the critical journeys: CSV upload to dashboard refresh, log ingestion to metrics display, filtering, and error states. Run in CI against an ephemeral environment. Document how to run locally.

tasks.name: Performance & load testing
tasks.details: Test dashboard and pipeline performance with realistic volumes: large CSV files, high log throughput, and concurrent dashboard users. Identify bottlenecks, record baselines, and fix or file follow-ups for anything outside target thresholds.

tasks.name: Deployment pipeline & monitoring
tasks.details: Automate build/deploy to staging and production with approvals, environment config management, and rollback. Add health checks, uptime/error alerts, and basic dashboards for the platform itself. Document runbook essentials.

tasks.name: Documentation & launch handover
tasks.details: Write user-facing dashboard guide, data source/pipeline docs, architecture overview, and operational runbook. Run a launch readiness review against milestone acceptance criteria and record known limitations plus the post-launch backlog.
